text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I came to watch training,
I ran into Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi on the track.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san from before!
Thank you so much for your encouragement the other day!
choice_data_list: How are things going for you?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm giving it my absolute all!
With my very own training routine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She says this with utmost confidence, but
I wonder if she isn't pushing herself to the point of collapsing like last time...
choice_data_list: Mind if I watch your training?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Of course, by all means!
Please, do stick around and watch!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... *phew*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems my worries were unfounded. Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
is handling her training without a hitch.
At this rate, there's no need to worry about her collapsing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, what she's performing are basic drills,
and so far, there doesn't seem to be anything special about them.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Alright, feeling like this,
I can definitely do one more round on the slope!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In complete contrast, her sprint workouts on the turf
are intensely rigorous.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If it's me, I should be able
to launch my final spurt even earlier.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Alright, one more time!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Keeping the slope runs to a low load over a few sets,
while pushing hard during final straightaway sprints on the turf...
It doesn't seem like she's just rushing into this blindly.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: How was it? What do you think of my custom training routine?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I incorporated what you told me before,
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Since then, I took another close look
at my classmates' training to analyze them.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Waking up early every morning to research everything,
I finally realized something.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
My acceleration on the final straightaway
isn't one bit behind Spe-chan's!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And when it comes to lower body strength,
even El-chan is building it up step by step over time.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I realized that both I and everyone else
have our strong points and our weak points.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So, I decided to play to my strengths!
Make my strong points even stronger!
And close the gap on my weak points, little by little...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, I'll stick to baseline training
that my body can reliably handle!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: After all, pushing too hard and collapsing ruins everything!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
This is the training routine I came up with
to compete alongside my classmates!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accepting the weaknesses of her own physical condition
while doing everything she possibly can... This is truly—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
R-Really?
!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, that makes me feel kind of embarrassed...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning to run a bit more today.
Please watch if you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no turning that down.
Following her invitation,
I decided to stay and watch the rest of her training.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her training doesn't possess the sheer dynamicity
of Special Week or El Condor Pasa...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I think I can still run more!
Alright, one more lapーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet her posture of facing any adversity head-on
with boundless positivity... In that regard alone,
perhaps no one can surpass her.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *pant*...
*huffff*... *wheeeze*...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Fu... fuhiii~............
I might have... gotten a bit carried away...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi... In more ways than one,
I might need to keep a close eye on her from now on...
